item.title: রিমা প্রতিদিন সকালে কোথায় যায়?
item.dc:creator: smcq-demo
item.category: Original Demo Bank (not previous exam questions)

item.content:encoded:
Smart MCQ Manager — Demo Site

Welcome to the Smart MCQ Manager sample website. This is an original educational demonstration, not a collection of past-exam questions.

Demo questions are available in WordPress Dashboard → Smart MCQ → All Questions. Student features require a logged-in WordPress account.

Available Student Pages

Administrators: the five imported demo examinations are DRAFTS and do not yet have question IDs. Open each under Smart MCQ → Exams, use “Save Exam & Generate Questions”, then publish and add its generated shortcode to a page. WordPress Importer cannot automatically remap this plugin’s exam question IDs.
